secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for sending email notifications when the contact form is submitted. Get it from https://resend.com/api-keys after creating an account. Optional — without it the contact form returns 503.

secrets.name: CONTACT_NOTIFY_EMAIL
secrets.description: Email address that receives contact form notifications. Must match the Resend account email until knoux.store is verified on Resend.
